lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Visible as a grid-like arrangement of roughly circular high-luminance pixel clusters posterior to the gill slits, forming approximately five identifiable vertical columns between the primary horizontal ridges.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical columns of elevated spot density intersect with the horizontal planes of the lateral carinae to form a structured series of anchor nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal linear features are visible along the upper and mid flank, characterized by a sharp vertical luminance gradient with higher intensity on the dorsal-facing edge and lower intensity on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin exhibits a high-density population of smaller high-luminance blobs with a more randomized spatial distribution compared to the structured grid of the lateral flank.
